doc.title: Mose Allison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Signing with Atlantic through Nesuhi Ertegun
summary: He went in and Ertegun signed him on the spot at Columbus Circle.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: Let’s talk about the years at Atlantic. You’re on the roster with...well, Ray Charles isn’t there any longer, but Aretha Franklin... So many people who became icons of American music are on the same label, and you’re putting out records regularly for the next 15 years. Can you talk about how you were recruited to the label? You’ve said that you were friends with Neshui Ertegun.
I went in to talk to Neshui Ertegun, and he signed me right away.
He called you? Your contract was up?
No, he signed me right there at Atlantic Records. They used to be on...
